entity.description: How a team member takes cases (design AgentTeams TeamParticipation), effective-dated beside the dated membership: whether assignment rules may pick them, the most open cases they hold, the agent who takes their turn when they are out, and the calendar of their working hours (else their own schedule calendar, else the team's). Saved by mantle.request.SupportCaseServices.save#ServiceTeamMember.

An assignment rule of a service queue (design AssignmentRules), effective-dated with its key fields audit-logged: its order among the queue's rules (sequenceNum, the lowest first), its conditions (ServiceAssignmentCondition rows, all must hold), the distribution (manual leaves the case for an agent to take; round robin; least open), who is eligible (the team, the queue's by default, and optionally only some of its members), whether their working hours count, the most open cases an agent may hold, and the fallback assignee. A draft has no from date; a change of a published rule is a new row naming the one it replaces (previousRuleId), which it ends; rootRuleId is the first row's id, which the cursor is kept by. Saved by mantle.request.SupportCaseServices.save#AssignmentRule.

field.name: eligiblePartyIds
field.description: Only these members of the team, comma separated; empty: every member

moqui.basic.Enumeration.description: Left for an agent to take

entity.description: A typed condition of an assignment rule row (design AssignmentRuleEdit; F71): an allowlisted case field, an operator that field takes and a value of its type, checked by save#AssignmentRule. A rule's conditions are its row's: a change of a published rule copies them onto its new row.

The distribution state of an assignment rule (design AssignmentRules: a record of its own, locked with the assignment so two intakes cannot take the same slot), kept by the rule's first row (rootRuleId) across its changes: the agent round robin gave the last case, and the last result for the rule list.

A saved reply's service facts (design SavedReplies; CS-REPLIES, D24), keyed by its Comms text block (moqui.basic.email.EmailTextBlock, which holds the title, shortcut, body, owner and the group it is shared with: personal, a team's group or the service-wide group): the organization it is for, its language, the variables it uses, and whether it is offered. Its case actions are SavedReplyAction rows.

field.name: variableNames
field.description: The variables the text uses, comma separated (as the last save found them)

field.name: subject
field.description: The subject of the reply when it starts a thread

entity.description: A case action of a saved reply (design SavedReplies ReplyEdit), in sequence: set the status (with a resolution or reason), add a tag, assign (an agent, or the user who applies it), set the priority, or add an internal note. apply#SavedReply runs them on the case with the reply, in one transaction, after the agent saw them in preview#SavedReply.

A request that is a support case: the service policy and case workflow it was opened under, the queue it entered, the accepted intake time (the received date of the mail it came by, else the request date), the message it came from, the template (P7) and the close date (P8). Written by mantle.request.SupportCaseServices.ensure#CaseProfile and create#Case only.

field.name: intakeCategoryId
field.description: The queue the case entered

field.name: templateFormId
field.description: The case template (a DbForm) its values were taken on (P7)

field.name: formResponseId
field.description: The case's template values (P7): a FormResponse of templateFormId, read as of its response date (SupportCaseServices.get#CaseTemplateValues)

moqui.basic.Enumeration.description: Its team and the service managers
A request to review, not a case

entity.description: The service settings of a queue (a RequestCategory with an owner organization), effective-dated: the types it offers, who sees its cases, its responsible team, its default assignment rule (P5), service level policy (P4) and template (P7), and the fallback assignee. A category with a current row is a service queue, and a request in it is a case. Saved by mantle.request.SupportCaseServices.save#ServiceQueue.

field.name: offeredTypeEnumIds
field.description: The RequestType ids the queue offers, comma separated; empty offers the organization's service-enabled types

entity.description: A request type as an organization offers it for cases (design CaseTypes), effective-dated: whether it is service-enabled (a request of this type with a Customer party of the organization and no category goes into its default queue and is a case), its customer label, default queue, priority and workflow, and whether the customer pages offer it. Saved by mantle.request.SupportCaseServices.save#ServiceRequestType.

An organization's service defaults (design ServiceDefaults), effective-dated; an organization with a current row has Customer Service configured and its requests may be cases. The default queue and workflow, what an unknown sender makes, the reopen window, the auto-close delay (P8), whether resolving needs a resolution, and customerImmediateCancel (P10, off). Saved by mantle.request.SupportCaseServices.save#ServiceDefaults.

What a request status means on a case of a workflow (design StatusCategories), effective-dated: the agent's and the customer's labels, the category (Open, Paused, Resolved, Closed, Cancelled), whether a pause needs a reason, and the order on the board. Saved by save#CaseStatusMapping.

A move a case of a workflow may make (design CaseTransitionPolicy), effective-dated: from and to status, whether it needs a resolution or a reason, whether it needs SUPPORT_CASE_MANAGE, and whether the customer is told. transition#Case allows only a current row's move (each also a StatusFlowTransition of the Default flow). Saved by save#CaseWorkflow.

How one channel files into a service queue of an organization, effective-dated: the channel (mail, the queue's public form, a forum category of a PASS site, chat), for mail the account (empty: any account whose Comms rule names the queue), for the forum the site and its category, the type, priority and template of what it files, what an unknown sender (else the ServicePolicy's) and an automatic message make, whether a new case is acknowledged and with which text block and identity, the public form's hourly limit and its token's life in days, and the last error an intake met on it.

field.name: requestCategoryId
field.description: The queue

field.name: siteId
field.description: The PASS site (mantle.public.PublicSite)

field.name: forumContactListId
field.description: The forum category (its ContactList)

field.name: ackTextBlockId
field.description: The acknowledgement's text (moqui.basic.email.EmailTextBlock), with ${requestId}, ${requestName} and ${queueName}

entity.description: How an organization invites a resolved case's customer to give feedback (design FeedbackDeliveryPolicy), effective-dated with its key fields audit-logged: the case types and queues it covers (comma separated; empty: all), the delay after resolution, once per case or once per resolution, the feedback form, the channel (email), the days the link works, the reminders (how many, how many days apart), the score at or below which a follow-up is made, the team that follows up and in how many days. An invitation keeps the row it was made under. Saved by mantle.request.CaseFeedbackServices.save#InvitationPolicy.

The follow-up of a low score (design ResponseDetail FeedbackFollowUp): the invitation and response, the case and its organization, the score, the team and the person it is assigned to, when it is due, what was done (an action and a note) and its state (open, acknowledged, done). The response itself is never changed.

A wiki space, or the part of it under a page path, an organization's service desk draws articles from (design KnowledgeSources), effective-dated with its key fields audit-logged: its audience (internal: agents only; customer: signed-in customers; public: anyone), the language of its pages, the queue or product category it is first for, its search priority, whether it is suggested at all, the team that reviews its feedback and suggested edits, and where an article drafted from a case goes (draftWikiSpaceId, under draftParentPath). A page belongs to the current source of its space with the longest matching pagePathPrefix. Saved by mantle.request.KnowledgeServices.save#ServiceKnowledgeSource.

field.name: pagePathPrefix
field.description: The page path the source covers (the page and the pages under it); empty for the whole space

field.name: localeLanguage
field.description: The language of the source's pages, a language code (en, es); suggestions in the requester's language come first

field.name: requestCategoryId
field.description: The queue whose cases it is suggested first for

field.name: productCategoryId
field.description: The product category it is suggested first for

field.name: sequenceNum
field.description: The search priority, lowest first

entity.description: A reader's report on one version of an article (design ArticleFeedback): helpful or not, an optional plain-text comment, the case it was read for, who gave it (an agent from a case, or a customer from the Support app, P15) and the organization whose source the article is in; then its review: the decision, the note, who reviewed it and when, and the task made or linked for an improvement. A record of its own, never changed by an edit of the article. Recorded by record#ArticleFeedback, reviewed by review#ArticleFeedback.

field.name: versionName
field.description: The version read (the published one when it was given)

field.name: comment
field.description: Plain text, no markup kept

field.name: workEffortId
field.description: The task made or linked for the improvement

entity.description: One decision on an order change at its revision (as mantle.order.purchase.PurchaseApprovalDecision): who decided, what, when, why and until when an approval holds, the order revision it saw and the ServicePolicy row it was decided under (a customer's immediate cancel under customerImmediateCancel names the policy and no user). Written only by mantle.order.OrderChangeServices. An approval is current while the proposal's revision is the one it names, it is not superseded and its expiry has not passed.

field.name: sourceRevision
field.description: The proposal's revision decided (the time of its last key-field change, in milliseconds)

entity.description: What an organization's Support app offers its customers (design ServiceDefaults, the Support mount's settings), effective-dated with its key fields audit-logged: the service queues a signed-in customer may file a case into (comma separated requestCategoryIds; empty: the organization's default queue), the case types offered there (empty: each queue's own), and the wiki spaces whose customer and public knowledge sources the help pages read (empty: every customer and public source). Saved by mantle.request.SupportCaseServices.save#SupportAppSetting.

One link of a case's lineage: from the source case (fromRequestId) to the other (toRequestId), a merge (the source merged into the case kept), a split (the new case split from the source) or a follow-up (the new case following up the closed or cancelled one). Who made it (userId; empty for a customer's reply), when, the reason, the operation key and the source's revision it was made against.

field.name: fromRevision
field.description: The source case's revision the relation was made against (SupportCases.js revisionOf)

entity.description: What a case relation referenced or carried (its evidence): a message (a CommunicationEvent, and the mail of a follow-up), a file (a RequestContent of the source, which stays there), a linked record or a work item (linked to the other case too) or a service level clock carried by a merge (the source's episode and its carried copy), each with its audience (CaseFieldAudience: CfaCustomer or CfaInternal) as it was on the source. toRequestId is the case the item was referenced on, so the rules on that case know a referenced message is no new reply or response.

field.name: caseSlaEpisodeId
field.description: The source's clock (CriClock)

field.name: carriedEpisodeId
field.description: Its carried copy on the case kept, when it was open

entity.description: A service level policy of an organization (design ServiceLevelPolicies SlaPolicyEdit), effective-dated: its conditions (a service queue, a request type, a customer, a service agreement; none is the organization's default), the calendar its business time is counted on (empty: the queue's team's working hours), whether an internal hold pauses resolution, the longest pause before a warning, and what a reopen does. The most specific policy whose conditions all hold applies (agreement, then customer, then queue, then type, then the default; impl-customer-service §4); two published rows with the same conditions over the same dates are refused. A row replacing another names it (previousPolicyId). Saved by mantle.request.SlaServices.save#Policy.

field.name: requestCategoryId
field.description: A service queue

field.name: agreementId
field.description: A service agreement (AgrService) of the organization with the customer

field.name: timeZone
field.description: The zone of a policy counted around the clock (no calendar)

field.name: holdPauses
field.description: Y: an internal hold (ReqOnHold) pauses resolution as waiting for the customer does

field.name: maxPauseMinutes
field.description: A pause longer than this (business minutes) warns; never a successful resolution

moqui.basic.Enumeration.description: A new resolution clock with the full target
No resolution clock after a reopen

entity.description: A policy row's targets for one priority band (CasePriorityBand), effective-dated with its row: the first response and resolution in business minutes, and how long before each is due a warning goes. A band with no target has no clock.

One clock of a case (design CaseDetail's clocks, CaseAnalytics): first response (one per case, never restarted) or resolution (a new one each time the case reopens, sequenceNum 1, 2, ...), bound at its start to the policy row, target and calendar (with its zone and organization) chosen then, with its target and warning in business minutes. Its times: start, due and warning (stored, so a later holiday or hours edit changes none), actual (the response or resolution), the pause running (pausedDate) and the business minutes paused so far, the warning and breach the scan recorded. State: running, paused, met, missed (done late), unmet (the case closed without it) or cancelled (the case was cancelled; out of the success rate).

What happened to a case's clocks, in order (design CaseAnalytics; D23): received, each status change from any path, an outward response accepted by its channel, a customer reply, work made or linked, a pause and a resume with the reason, met or missed, a reopen, a warning, a breach, a pause past its limit, a due date changed outside the service levels, and a manager's correction (the earlier and the new due date, the reason). Never edited or deleted. eventKey makes a rule or a scan that runs twice record once.

moqui.basic.Enumeration.description: Due date changed outside service levels

entity.description: One decision on a warranty claim at its revision (as mantle.order.purchase.PurchaseApprovalDecision, F45): the coverage it was decided on (the basis, the terms and their source, the coverage end and its source, a manual override of the end with its reason), the outcome (covered, partial, rejected or goodwill), why, who decided and when, who approved a goodwill or an override (WARRANTY_APPROVE), and for a chargeable repair the charge estimate in its currency and the customer's consent; the sales quote of a chargeable repair waits for Sales (impl-customer-service §4, §7). Written only by mantle.request.WarrantyServices. The current decision is the newest one at the claim's revision that is not superseded.

field.name: sourceRevision
field.description: The claim's revision decided (Request.claimRevision)

field.name: coverageBasisEnumId
field.description: What the coverage was read from (WarrantyCoverageBasis): an agreement, the product's warranty at sale, or none (goodwill only)

field.name: termsText
field.description: The terms decided on, as the agent read them

field.name: termsSourceText
field.description: Where the terms come from: the agreement and its term, or the product's warranty feature

field.name: coverageEndDate
field.description: The coverage end decided on: the lookup's, or the manual override

field.name: overrideReason
field.description: Why the coverage end was overridden (required with an override)

field.name: approvedByUserId
field.description: A goodwill decision or a coverage override: the holder of WARRANTY_APPROVE who made it

field.name: chargeEstimate
field.description: A chargeable repair: what the customer is asked to pay

field.name: customerConsentRef
field.description: A chargeable repair: the customer's consent (a message, a call, a reference); a repair is linked only once it is recorded
